family.description: This entry, previously known as DUF2213, represents the Pseudomonas phage Pa193 gp24 scaffolding protein and various hypothetical and phage-related proteins. The structure of gp24 was partly resolved featuring small helical hairpin [[cite:PUB00163741]]. gp24 functions as a scaffolding protein for capsid assembly. It forms a pentamer that probably is directly stabilizing the capsid five-fold vertices [[cite:PUB00163741]].
family.name: Pa193 gp24 scaffolding protein
